data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest editorial image for an organic product post
Input images: Image 1 is the exact product reference and the product identity must remain visually faithful.
Primary request: Create a sophisticated late-night architecture-studio still life in which the exact small blue Butt Station desk organizer is genuinely being used to repair a torn architectural blueprint with clear tape.
Scene/backdrop: a warm walnut drafting desk with one cream blueprint sheet, one sharp black pencil, and a metal task lamp; understated architecture studio, not a corporate boardroom.
Subject: the exact small desk organizer from Image 1: a smooth bright-blue seated human-like figure on a white toilet-bowl base; one bent arm carries a real clear tape roll; the extended blue leg ends in the tape cutter; a lime-yellow rectangular block behind it holds one blue pen; a few colored paperclips rest in the small white bowl. A short strip of clear tape extends naturally from the roll across one clean tear in the blueprint toward the cutter, showing the product doing its actual job.
Style/medium: believable high-end editorial interiors photography, natural material texture, restrained and witty, not glossy ad photography.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3, intimate three-quarter close-up, whole product fully visible and ordinary desk-organizer scale, product centered slightly low with the blueprint creating one clean diagonal; quiet negative space above, no border or layout.
Lighting/mood: warm pool of tungsten task-lamp light with cool blue evening shadows; dry, intelligent humor.
Color palette: walnut brown, blueprint cream, charcoal, and the product's exact bright blue, white, lime-yellow, and clear plastic accents.
Materials/textures: smooth molded blue plastic, matte white plastic bowl/base, transparent tape with one realistic highlight, paper blueprint fibers, worn walnut grain.
Text: Do not add any text anywhere. Blueprint markings may be abstract lines only and must not form words.
Constraints: preserve the product's strange seated anatomy and all functional parts from Image 1; one blue figure only; one tape roll only; the figure must not become a real person, toy character, toilet, or generic sculpture; no duplicated limbs; no extra stationery; no brand marks; no CTA; no badges; no product-card frame; no watermark; no template; no surreal scale.
Avoid: ad copy, price tags, packaging, hands, people, exaggerated comedy props, extra tape dispensers, malformed anatomy, illegible pseudo-text, overly polished ecommerce lighting.
notes: Generated with the exact downloaded Amazon primary image as the strict identity reference.
The repository copy was inspected at full useful resolution.
